name: Loss of control
definition: AI becoming uncontrollable or escaping the control of the people running it: superintelligence, catastrophic or existential risk, extinction, rogue or deceptive AI systems.
gdelt: "artificial intelligence" (extinction OR superintelligence OR "existential risk" OR "loss of control" OR "catastrophic risk")
match: extinction|superintelligen|existential risk|loss of control|catastrophic risk|destroy humanity|wipe out humanity|kill us all|doomsday
because: AI might get away from the people running it

name: China race
definition: Losing an AI race to China or other foreign adversaries: national security competition, adversaries gaining AI or chip advantages, AI dominance.
gdelt: "artificial intelligence" China (race OR dominance OR "national security" OR "export controls")
because: China is ahead, or about to be

name: Job loss
definition: AI replacing workers: automation, layoffs, unemployment, displacement of jobs or wages.
gdelt: "artificial intelligence" (layoffs OR unemployment OR "job losses" OR "replace workers")
match: layoff|unemployment|job loss|jobs? cut|replace workers|replacing workers|white.collar jobs|entry.level jobs
because: AI is coming for the jobs

name: Power bills and data centers
definition: Data centers for AI raising electricity or water costs, straining the power grid, or harming the environment and communities.
gdelt: "data centers" (electricity OR "power bills" OR grid OR "utility rates" OR ratepayers)
because: data centers are taking the power and the water

name: Kids and chatbots
definition: AI harming children or teens: companion chatbots, minors' safety or mental health, grooming, exploitation, age-inappropriate AI content.
gdelt: chatbot (children OR teens OR minors OR kids)

name: AI therapists
definition: An AI giving therapy, counselling or mental health care, advertising itself as a licensed mental health professional, or standing in for one.
gdelt: ("AI therapist" OR "AI therapy" OR "mental health chatbot" OR "chatbot therapist" OR "therapy chatbot") (psychotherapy OR counseling OR counselling OR "mental health")
because: an AI is standing in for a therapist

name: Deepfakes
definition: Synthetic or manipulated media: deepfakes, digital replicas, AI impersonation, election deepfakes, nonconsensual intimate imagery, AI-generated fraud.

name: AI cyberattacks
definition: AI-enabled hacking or cyberattacks, including attacks on critical infrastructure.
gdelt: "artificial intelligence" (cyberattack OR cyberattacks OR hackers OR ransomware)
because: AI makes an attack on the grid easier

name: Bioweapons
definition: AI helping create biological, chemical, radiological, or nuclear weapons, or engineered pandemics.
gdelt: "artificial intelligence" (bioweapon OR bioweapons OR "biological weapons" OR biosecurity)
because: AI could help somebody build a weapon

name: Algorithmic bias
definition: AI discriminating against people in decisions such as hiring, lending, housing, insurance, health care, or policing.
gdelt: "artificial intelligence" (bias OR discrimination) (hiring OR lending OR housing OR insurance)
because: an algorithm decides who gets hired, housed, or lent to
